/start: Sends only the active character card's opening message and stores it as an assistant turn.
/help: Opens this guide. Choose a category, then choose a command to view its behavior and available input form.
/status: Shows the active character, session, model, response language, persona, World Info, memory, RAG, group, and generation state.
/new: Creates and activates a separate session. Existing sessions and their transcripts remain unchanged.
/reset: Opens confirmation first. Confirming clears the active session conversation, purges chat Hindsight memory, and sends the character opening greeting.
/session: Opens session controls for switching, creating, or deleting inactive sessions. Busy or active sessions cannot be deleted.
/sync: Opens manual bidirectional SillyTavern JSONL sync. Export sends the active session to Telegram as a compatible file; Import accepts a validated file, preserves the active session data, and selects the new imported session afterward.
/providers: Opens the provider/model catalog. Select an adapter-enabled model; catalog-only entries cannot run inference.
/providers refresh: Opens the provider panel, where Refresh models updates discoverable provider catalogs.
/providers health: Opens the provider panel, where Provider health checks configured endpoints without exposing credentials.
/character: Opens character selection, card information, upload guidance, and safe deletion controls.
/persona: Opens persona selection. Persona changes apply to the active session prompt.
/world: Opens World Info selection. Multiple validated JSON lorebooks can be active together.
/note: Opens Author's Note controls: Off clears it, and User input consumes the next scoped text message.
/systemprompt: Opens the TXT System Prompt picker. The prompt body stays private and is applied during generation.
/language: Opens per-session model reply language controls. Auto follows the user's language; fixed codes force a language.
/settings: Opens generation settings. Choose reasoning or enter validated values for temperature, token limits, sampling, penalties, and stop sequences.
/stream on|off: Opens streaming controls. Streaming edits a temporary preview and sends the complete final response afterward.
/preset: Opens preset controls for applying, saving, or deleting validated generation settings.
/macro <text>: Previews the supported SillyTavern macros without allowing shell, filesystem, or arbitrary network execution.
/stscript note|reset: Runs the allowlisted STscript subset. Reset still requires the normal confirmation panel.
/regen: Generates a new response variant for the latest user turn.
/swipe: Opens stored response variants. Browse them and keep one as the selected response.
/branch: Opens the response branch selector for the active session.
/continue: Continues the latest assistant response using the current session context.
/edit <text>: Replaces the latest user turn and regenerates while preserving the previous branch until the new response succeeds.
/retry: Retries the latest failed response without creating a duplicate committed assistant turn.
/prompt: Shows safe prompt diagnostics such as active character, history, summary, memory, RAG, group, and World Info state.
/memory: Opens Hindsight memory mode and scope controls. Search remains a free-text query.
/remember <fact>: Queues one explicit long-term fact for Hindsight, subject to the character and chat memory policy.
/summarize: Regenerates the active session summary from stored transcript content.
/databank: Opens Data Bank RAG controls for status, listing, removal, and reindexing.
/tts <text>: Converts supplied text to a voice message through the configured TTS provider.
/voice_input on|off: Opens transcription, STT model, and language controls.
/voice_input language: Opens STT language controls, including Auto, fixed codes, and scoped User input.
/group: Available only inside a Telegram Forum Topic. Opens topic-local group controls and the New group session wizard.
